subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should persisted selectedSkillPaths become the supported GitHub source contract after this branch is rebased and dry-run semantics are fixed?
rationale: The PR changes stored GitHub source configuration and existing-source sync behavior, which automation cannot accept as product policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Sources
options.body: Rebase onto current main, drop the merged warm-up overlap, fix dry-run selected counts, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

options.title: Accept The Contract As-Is
options.body: Maintain the persisted selected-path contract while explicitly owning the legacy all-skills behavior and dry-run semantics before landing.

options.title: Pause Persisted Selection
options.body: Keep the draft paused if maintainers do not want selected skill paths to become part of the GitHub source model yet.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Sources
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, drop the merged warm-up overlap, fix dry-run selected counts, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and most recently maintained the GitHub-backed source sync contract this PR extends.
